title: Sponsor partners disagree on a major decision
summary: Go back to the partner agreement's decision and deadlock terms and resolve it before it reaches investors.

situation.trigger: The principals cannot agree on a decision the business needs to make.

outlineSteps: Write down the decision in dispute and each partner's position
Read the partner agreement's decision, vote and deadlock terms
List the deadlines the dispute puts at risk
Gather the facts and figures each side relies on
Meet to decide under the agreement's process
Use the agreement's mediation or buy-sell steps if still stuck
Bring in counsel if the agreement's remedies come into play
Record the decision and how it was reached
Tell investors what the governing documents require
